Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Main Street core with the Emerson Center, the Ellen Theatre, and the downtown mixed-use corridor anchored by redevelopment along Main, Willson, and Tracy.

Bozeman Armory.name: Bozeman Armory
Bozeman Armory.description: Armory block south of Main with the historic Armory Hall, gallery district, and craft-beer-anchored infill along the MSU boulevard edge.

North 7th Avenue.name: North 7th Avenue
North 7th Avenue.description: North 7th Avenue industrial-to-residential corridor with Midtown Urban Renewal District incentives, warehouse conversions, and the Cannery District redevelopment.

Bozeman Health.name: Bozeman Health
Bozeman Health.description: Bozeman Health Deaconess Hospital anchor corridor with medical-office demand, clinic expansion, and associated multifamily development.

North Park.name: North Park
North Park.description: North Park Urban Renewal District at the city's north edge with master-planned residential subdivisions, the North Park business park, and new-build hometracts.

Story Mill.name: Story Mill
Story Mill.description: Northeast Neighborhood Urban Renewal District with the Story Mill community garden, Baxter Meadows, and the historic mill-redevelopment corridor along E Story Mill Road.

South Bozeman Tech.name: South Bozeman Tech
South Bozeman Tech.description: South Bozeman Technology District west of 19th Avenue with tech-firm campuses, R&D flex space, and the metro's highest commercial-valuation corridor.

Valley West.name: Valley West
Valley West.description: Valley West Drive and West Main Street corridor with low-density residential subdivisions, big-box retail, and the West Main auto-oriented commercial strip.

Bridger College.name: Bridger College
Bridger College.description: Montana State University campus anchor corridor with College Street student housing, university mixed-use development, and the Grant Street innovation belt.

Baxter/Highland.name: Baxter/Highland
Baxter/Highland.description: Baxter Lane and Highland Boulevard southern corridor with single-family stock, the Highland Park subdivision, and steady low-valuation alteration permits.
